fields.statement: QA at dc287cd2d with the built binary: scratch Rhiza root (own HOME) with one registered project, four autonomous failed runs whose change sets are draft, draft, withdrawn (rhiza withdraw) and rejected (rhiza propose + reject), and a daemon state seeding each with a spent budget (2 of 2) and a saved hold; rhiza inbox listed 4 'stalled run' items. Ran rhiza run abandon on the second run (inbox still 4 until a poll, as specified), then rhiza daemon --once --max-runs 0: state watchdog_holds kept only the plain failed run, rhiza inbox showed 1 stalled item (that run, with its tried attempts), budget memory for all four kept; a second poll stayed at 1. Control: re-seeding the 4 holds and polling with a build of the merge-base kept all 4 stalled items; the change's build then dropped them back to 1. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestWatchdog(Budget|Holds)' PASS.
